results.name: Tech Society — ByteForce
results.description: The premier technical society organizing hackathons, coding contests, workshops, and tech talks. Open to all engineering students.

results.name: Literary Society — Quill & Ink
results.description: For lovers of language and literature. Conducts debates, creative writing sessions, poetry recitals, and publishes the college magazine.

results.name: Cultural Society — Rang Tarang
results.description: Celebrates art and culture through dance, music, drama, and fashion. Organizes the annual cultural fest and inter-college competitions.

results.name: Sports Club — Blaze
results.description: Manages all sports activities including inter-college tournaments, annual sports day, and fitness workshops. Facilities include cricket, basketball, and athletics.
